info.title: NexStatus
info.author: ILALEX
info.details:
NexStatus shows who is online on Nextendo. The home screen lists games with a live player count, and opening a game shows its rooms and the players in them. After you sign in with a QR code, friends are marked in the list. Counts refresh about every 15 seconds while the app is open.

An Ultrahand overlay shows the same public totals without signing in. Updates can be installed from inside the app.

AI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: icon/banner art.

changelog:
v1.2.1
What's new

Switch homebrew and the Ultrahand overlay are 1.2.1. The Android app is 1.2.0.

- The homebrew list includes all 63 games from the status page, including Portal 2. Servers that do not answer stay in the list as Offline. If a status cannot be read, the game shows No status.
- Player counts use the same sources as the website. Catalog games, including Stardew Valley, use the service catalog. When signed in, the number matches the live player list, including someone who is in the game but not in a lobby.
- Under the player total, the homebrew app shows Servers, then Online and Offline. Offline includes games with no status, so the two numbers add up to the full list.
- The overlay still lists only games with at least one player. A game page always shows Lobbies. If there are none, it says there are no lobbies right now, then lists the players.

Set Ultrahand Overlay memory- to 8 MB- before opening the overlay. The 4 MB default is too small and can fail to load the overlay or crash Atmosphere.

 Switch
Extract nexstatus.zip at the root of the SD card.

 Android
Install nexstatus.apk. This release updates the Android app to 1.2.0. It lists all 63 games with Online, Offline, or No status, uses the same counts as the website, and shows Servers with Online and Offline under the player total. It checks GitHub for a newer APK on launch.
